checks.reason: OPS-02 proven on AWS: with the repository's alert rules loaded into Prometheus scraping the API's metrics, one tenant sent 600 requests 40 at a time and was refused 114 times (HTTP 429) while a second tenant's 20 concurrent requests were all served (p95 5020 ms); the dashboard's tenant-filtered refusal panel showed 114 refusals for the flooding tenant and none for the quiet one; public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx@sha256:df80ece7fa07f8ed4f3b70e883fe322732954d0287e562f1fdc790018f7d2c66 on ECS Fargate behind an ALB served all 187 HTTP probes (one a second) through a 234 s control-plane outage: the control store stopped (ZenithControlStoreDown fired after 140 s), then the API and worker stopped too for 70 s; after the restart the store reported up and the tenant was served again. Not covered: traces in a trace backend, worker-side metrics, Grafana UI import (proven locally by the import harness), Temporal-backed fairness
